theme.title: Five on the Floor
theme.subtitle: Teams, stars and stories from across basketball
theme.recap: The best numbers come from all over basketball history. Which answer surprised you most?

questions.prompt: How many games did the 2015 Hawks win in an undefeated January?
questions.note: 17–0: Atlanta entered January at 23–8 and left it at 40–8, on the way to 60 wins.

funFacts.text: Atlanta stayed perfect both at Philips Arena and away from home during January.
The month closed with a home victory over Philadelphia.
The Hawks entered January at 23–8 and exited at 40–8.

questions.prompt: The chart shows three other modern big men's rebounding. What did Bam Adebayo average for the 2019–20 Heat?
questions.note: 10.2 in his breakout season, plus 368 assists: Bam's passing is what set him apart from the bigs beside him.

funFacts.text: Bam joined Butler on Miami's 2020 All-Star contingent.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Jimmy Butler and Bam Adebayo were both selected into 2020 NBA All-Star Game

funFacts.text: His rim protection included 93 blocks in the regular season.

questions.prompt: Boston needed a record number of playoff games to win the 2008 title. How many?
questions.note: 26: seven games each against Atlanta and Cleveland, then six apiece to beat Detroit and the Lakers.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: the Celtics set an NBA record for most playoff games ever needed to win a championship, with 26

funFacts.text: Boston survived Game 7 showdowns with both Atlanta and Cleveland before finally reaching Detroit.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: managed to prevail in a pair of Game 7s on their home court

funFacts.text: The Celtics finally broke their postseason road-win drought against the Pistons in the Eastern finals.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: The Celtics would finally break their road woes in a six-game win against the perennial Eastern Conference powerhouse Detroit Pistons

funFacts.text: Coach Doc Rivers had played for a Knicks team that held the old postseason games-played record.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Coach Doc Rivers played for the 1993–94 New York Knicks, which held the previous record

questions.prompt: Chauncey Billups averaged 21.0 as the 2004 Finals MVP of a starless Pistons team. What did 2014 Finals MVP Kawhi Leonard average?
questions.context: San Antonio Spurs vs Miami Heat · 2014 NBA Finals
questions.note: 17.8 on 61.2% shooting; at 22 he was the third-youngest Finals MVP, and all four Spurs wins came by 15-plus.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Overall, he averaged 17.8 points on 61.2 percent shooting in the series

funFacts.text: Kawhi was 22 years and 351 days old, the third-youngest Finals MVP.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Leonard was the third-youngest recipient of the award (22 years and 351 days old) since its inception in 1969

funFacts.text: He scored a career-high 29 in Game 3 to give San Antonio a 2–1 lead.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: The Spurs took a 2–1 lead in the series after a career-high 29 points from Leonard

funFacts.text: San Antonio won each of its four games against Miami by at least 15 points.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: They defeated Miami by margins of at least 15 points in each of their four wins

questions.prompt: The 2014 Spurs shot a Finals-record 75.8% in one half. What percent did Indiana shoot over the full 2024 Game 7 at Madison Square Garden?
questions.context: Pacers at Knicks · 2024 East semifinals · Game 7
questions.note: 67.1%, a playoff record; Indiana made 29 of its 38 first-half shots after trailing the series 0–2.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: The Pacers set an NBA playoff record for shooting percentage, making 67.1% of their shots in game 7 against the Knicks.

funFacts.text: Indiana shot a staggering 76.3% in the first half.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: The Pacers also set the highest shooting percentage rate in a half with 76.3%

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: making 29 out of 38 shots in the first half

funFacts.text: Indiana recovered from an 0–2 series deficit to advance.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: the Pacers ultimately prevailed and overcame an 0–2 series deficit for the first time ever.
